iast: oṃ pūrṇam adaḥ pūrṇam idaṃ pūrṇāt pūrṇam udacyate

tr.text: Om ! That is full; this is full, (for) from the full the full (indeed) arises. When the full is taken from the full, what remains is full indeed. Om! Peace! Peace! Peace!

takeaway: Whole comes from whole, and the whole remains: taking away from the infinite does not make it less. A way to begin from abundance rather than lack.
